## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `ernolf/<type>/<description>`
- [ ] Commits signed and signed off (`git commit -S --signoff`)
- [ ] Conventional Commits subject
- [ ] New files carry an SPDX header (or are covered by `REUSE.toml`)
- [ ] Tested against a real app via `NCMAKE_REF=<commit-sha> make <target>`
- [ ] CI is green
